title: Eastfield Water Canal Marking and Temporary Fix
notice: Synthetic demo material. Invented document; no real meeting, publication, email or call occurred.

blocks.text: Rowan Bell · Community Manager · call with Jonas Pike · May 2026

Jonas Pike reported two recent tasks concerning the Eastfield canal. First, he identified a persistent seep along the canal wall. He marked its location with bright chalk-marking paint so the repair crew could easily find it. The crew came the following week to address it.

Second, he described a separate issue at a junction valve. There was a persistent leak there. He wrapped the spot with a strip of inner tube and secured it with a hose clamp. He said that temporary fix held for three weeks until the replacement part arrived.
Jonas noted the weather’s been dry, which made the seep easier to spot. He said the inner tube was from an old wheelbarrow tire.
